components.title: Instant Photo
components.description: An instant photo print that slides out of a slot when it scrolls into view and develops from milky grey to full colour, with a caption and date on its wide bottom edge. Give each print a slight tilt to scatter a few; hovering picks one up and straightens it.

components.name: interactive-button
components.title: Interactive Button
components.description: A download button whose fill tracks real progress, with a percentage and a finished state.

components.name: line-mask-reveal
components.title: Line Mask Reveal
components.description: A headline whose lines rise one after another from behind their own masks when it comes into view, split exactly where the browser wraps the text.

components.name: magnetic-button
components.title: Magnetic Button
components.description: A button that gently magnetizes toward the cursor.

components.name: marquee-rows
components.title: Marquee Rows
components.description: Three labelled rows of feature chips (security, workflow, insight) that travel at their own pace in alternating directions, and ease to a stop under the pointer.

components.name: membership-card
components.title: Membership Card
components.description: A metal membership card that tilts toward the cursor, with a banknote-style security print that catches the light as it turns and one slow sweep of light when it first comes into view.

components.name: model-picker
components.title: Model Picker
components.description: A menu for choosing the AI model. Models are grouped by provider and searchable, and a side pane compares the one under the cursor: what it's good at, relative intelligence, speed and cost, context size and what it accepts. Models on a higher plan stay visible with an upgrade button. Works from the keyboard.

components.name: navbar-announce
components.title: Navbar Announce
components.description: A navbar with a dismissible announcement bar that folds away smoothly and stays dismissed.

components.name: navbar-condense
components.title: Navbar Condense
components.description: A full-width header that tightens into a floating, frosted capsule as the page scrolls.

components.name: navbar-mega
components.title: Navbar Mega
components.description: A full-width header whose mega menus glide and resize between triggers.

components.name: navbar-pill
components.title: Navbar Pill
components.description: A floating capsule with a sliding active pill.

components.name: payment-button
components.title: Payment Button
components.description: A checkout button that shows the amount, then processing, paid or failed, without changing size.

components.name: product-card
components.title: Product Card
components.description: A store product card: move across the photo to flip through it (swipe on phones), pick a color swatch to swap the photos, and add to cart from a button that rises over the photo on hover, with price, sale price, a short detail line and a tag.

components.name: profile-card
components.title: Profile Card
components.description: A team member card with a full-bleed portrait and the name set over it; on hover, focus or tap the bio, social links and a mail button rise over the photo, without the card changing size.

components.name: rotating-words
components.title: Rotating Words
components.description: A word in a headline that rotates through a list: the letters roll up in a wave and the line's width glides to each new word.

components.name: scramble-text
components.title: Scramble Text
components.description: A text animation component that cycles characters through random glyphs before settling.

components.name: scroll-fill
components.title: Scroll Fill
components.description: A paragraph whose words fill from faint to full ink as you scroll through it, with a soft edge between read and unread, finishing while the copy is still in view.

components.name: settings-profile
components.title: Settings Profile
components.description: A profile settings page: photo upload by click or drop with honest size and type checks, name, and a username with a live availability check that suggests a free one when it's taken. Changing the email sends a confirmation link and keeps the old address active until it's confirmed, with a timed resend. Language, time zone (with each zone's current time), date format and week start show today's date as you'll see it. Edits stay a draft until the save bar's Save or ⌘S, and Discard puts everything back.

components.name: shine-button
components.title: Shine Button
components.description: A CTA button with a sweeping shine highlight on hover.

components.name: slide-to-confirm
components.title: Slide to Confirm
components.description: A slider for irreversible actions: ink follows the thumb and turns the label white where it passes, then the thumb locks and confirms.

components.name: social-login-button
components.title: Social Login Button
components.description: Clean, accessible buttons for Google, Apple, and GitHub SSO.

components.name: split-button
components.title: Split Button
components.description: A primary action with a menu of alternatives: picking one makes it the main action, and running it turns its icon into a spinner, then a check.

components.name: stacking-cards
components.title: Stacking Cards
components.description: Cards that pin as you scroll and stack on top of each other, one screen of scrolling per card, with wheel and trackpad scrolling eased while the stack is on screen. The cards underneath ease back and darken a little while their top rows stay visible, so the finished stack reads as a list you can click to jump back, and each photo settles from a slight zoom as its card rises. Each card takes a label, title, description, facts, a link and an image or any visual.

components.name: star-button
components.title: Star Button
components.description: A star or upvote button whose count rolls like an odometer, carrying digit by digit, with an optional live GitHub star count.

components.name: stat-card
components.title: Stat Card
components.description: A metric card whose number rolls into place like an odometer while its line or bar chart draws in; scrub the chart with a pointer, a finger or the arrow keys and the number rolls to that day, then back to today.

components.name: testimonial-deck
components.title: Testimonial Deck
components.description: A stack of quote cards: drag or flick the top card away, or use the buttons or arrow keys, and the next one lifts into place. It loops, keeps the height of its longest quote and takes any quotes with name, role, company, photo and rating.

components.name: text-reveal
components.title: Text Reveal
components.description: Word-by-word blur reveal for headlines and copy.

components.name: theme-toggle
components.title: Theme Toggle
components.description: A theme button whose icon turns from sun to moon as an eclipse, while the page changes like the sky: dusk sweeps down, dawn rises.

components.name: waitlist-button
components.title: Waitlist Button
components.description: A waitlist button that opens into an email field, with the button becoming the submit, then a confirmation across the field.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Sections that ease open to their height while the content fades up behind, one at a time or several, with full keyboard support.

components.name: amount-pad
components.title: Amount Pad
components.description: A money field where each digit drops in and lands, commas slide into place as the number grows, the amount shrinks to fit, and a digit past the limit bounces off in red.

components.name: anagram-shuffle
components.title: Anagram Shuffle
components.description: Letters rearrange themselves into the next anagram.

components.name: announcement-pill
components.title: Announcement Pill
components.description: A small New pill for above a hero heading, with a band of light along its border and an arrow that grows on hover.

components.name: area-chart
components.title: Area Chart
components.description: A time-series chart with soft area washes and one crosshair that reads every series at once.

components.name: aurora
components.title: Aurora
components.description: Slow curtains of light with fine rays that lean toward the cursor.

components.name: avatar-stack
components.title: Avatar Stack
components.description: Overlapping avatars that fan on hover and spring apart into a named list on a card growing out of the row.

components.name: balloon-button
components.title: Balloon Button
components.description: An inflated, half-balloon button drawn with a WebGL shader, with folds along its seam and a springy dent when pressed.

components.name: bar-list
components.title: Bar List
components.description: A ranked list of top pages, referrers or countries whose rows slide to their new rank and resize when you switch lists.

components.name: blur-reveal
components.title: Blur Reveal
components.description: Letters sharpen out of a blur, one after another.

components.name: bookmark-button
components.title: Bookmark Button
components.description: A save button whose bookmark fills from the top like a dropped ribbon while the label rolls to Saved.

components.name: caustics
components.title: Caustics
components.description: Sunlight on a pool floor, from light rays bent by moving water; click to drop a ripple.

components.name: chain-copy
components.title: Chain Copy
components.description: A copy-link button whose chain icon snaps apart when pressed, flings two chips from the break, then swings back together and relinks as the label rolls to Copied.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A checkbox and checkbox group whose check draws itself on, morphs into a dash for a partly ticked select-all, and supports shift-click to tick a whole range at once.

components.name: classic-navbar
components.title: Classic Navbar
components.description: A full-width bar that hides while you scroll down and returns on scroll up, with an underline that slides to the current page. Links left, centred or right; zero to two CTAs.

components.name: code-block
components.title: Code Block
components.description: A code block that shows plain text at once and colours it in place with on-demand Shiki, with tabs that sync across blocks, marked lines, diffs, collapsing and a copy button.

components.name: cohort-retention
components.title: Cohort Retention
components.description: Weekly retention as the classic triangle: a row per signup cohort, a column per week, each cell shaded by the share still active. Cells fill in a diagonal wave as the weeks unlock. Above, the chosen cohort's curve draws against the dashed average and morphs to each new cohort. Hovering a cell crosses its row and week and reads the users kept and the gap to average; cells switch between shares and user counts.

components.name: collapsing-breadcrumb
components.title: Collapsing Breadcrumb
components.description: A breadcrumb that folds its middle crumbs into an ellipsis when space runs out and unfolds them in place on hover or tap, each crumb sliding open to its own width.

components.name: command-menu
components.title: Command Menu
components.description: A calm ⌘K command menu: fuzzy and server search, grouped results, nested pages, recents, hotkeys and full keyboard control, with optional filter pills.

components.name: compare-slider
components.title: Compare Slider
components.description: A before-and-after frame that sweeps in on first view, with a smooth draggable divider, keyboard support and labels that step aside.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context Menu
components.description: A menu that opens where you right-click or long-press, with submenus, checkable items and full keyboard control.

components.name: cookie-consent
components.title: Cookie Consent
components.description: A cookie consent banner that slides up after load, grows in place into per-category switches, remembers the visitor's choice in localStorage and reopens straight to their saved settings.

components.name: copy-button
components.title: Copy Button
components.description: A copy button whose two sheets slide together into a check while the label rolls to Copied.

components.name: diagonal-beams
components.title: Diagonal Beams
components.description: One soft light falling across sharp, slanted pleats in the dark, its edge dissolving into fine grain.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal that grows out of the button that opened it, holds focus, and eases back when another dialog opens on top.

components.name: disabled-reason
components.title: Disabled Reason
components.description: A disabled button that answers a press: it shakes, says why it's blocked, and moves focus to the field that needs fixing.

components.name: dither-gradient
components.title: Dither Gradient
components.description: A bending gradient drawn only in your colours through an ordered dither.

components.name: dot-grid
components.title: Dot Grid
components.description: A quiet grid of dots lit by a drifting wave and by the cursor.

components.name: download-button
components.title: Download Button
components.description: A download button whose arrow drops into its tray, fills with progress as the percentage counts up, then draws a check and offers Open.

components.name: draggable-letters
components.title: Draggable Letters
components.description: Letters you can pull apart; they spring home.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: A menu with icons, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus, a sliding highlight and full keyboard control.

components.name: effort-dial
components.title: Effort Dial
components.description: A gauge for customer effort scores: a gradient arc fills from green toward red as the knob follows your finger, ticks light as it passes, it settles into the nearest answer, and a hard answer asks what got in the way.

components.name: elastic-slider
components.title: Elastic Slider
components.description: A slider that stretches like rubber past its ends and springs back.

components.name: email-composer
components.title: Email Composer
components.description: An email composer with recipient chips and suggestions, contact cards on hover, drag-and-drop attachments with upload progress, and a send button that schedules.

components.name: energy-flow
components.title: Energy Flow
components.description: A home energy card with solar, battery, grid and house as four nodes and dots that flow along the links at a speed set by the power in kW. Hovering or tapping a node dims every link it isn't part of and shows where its power comes from or goes; below, today's solar and home use curves scrub by the hour and the day's totals count up live.

components.name: event-feed
components.title: Event Feed
components.description: A live feed card where new events drop in at the top with a soft highlight, push the rest down and age in real time.

components.name: expand-button
components.title: Expand Button
components.description: An icon-only button that springs open to reveal its label on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: fade-left-to-right
components.title: Fade In Left to Right
components.description: A soft-edged mask reveals the text from left to right.

components.name: falling-letters
components.title: Falling Letters
components.description: Letters drop in and settle with a small bounce.

components.name: file-card
components.title: File Card
components.description: A document card whose corner curls on hover to show the next page, with older versions stacked behind the sheet.

components.name: filter-grid
components.title: Filter Grid
components.description: Tabs over a grid of tiles that can sit in several tabs: tiles in both glide to their new places, leaving ones blur away, newcomers grow in one by one, and the grid's height eases to fit.

components.name: fold-tabs
components.title: Fold Tabs
components.description: Tabs that fold into an accordion when their container gets narrow, with the track, the active pill and every label carried across so the switch reads as one object changing shape.

components.name: fold-toolbar
components.title: Fold Toolbar
components.description: An icon button that unfolds into a tray of tools, pushing its neighbours aside, and folds back into whichever tool you pick.

components.name: folder-faq
components.title: Folder FAQ
components.description: An FAQ laid out as files in a drawer: each question peeks out on its tab, and opening one lifts it from the stack while the folders in front slide down to uncover the answer.

components.name: folder-peek
components.title: Folder Peek
components.description: A folder whose file previews rise and fan out on hover, fly out into a list when opened, and that takes files dropped onto it.

components.name: follow-button
components.title: Follow Button
components.description: A follow button whose plus folds into a check as it turns to Following, and warns with Unfollow on hover before you undo it.

components.name: gauge-dial
components.title: Gauge Dial
components.description: A 240-degree dial whose gradient arc fills behind a spring-driven knob, with lit ticks and a zone badge; drag it or use the arrow keys.

components.name: grain-gradient
components.title: Grain Gradient
components.description: Colour that folds slowly like silk, finished with film grain.

components.name: halftone
components.title: Halftone
components.description: A screen of lit dots: swirling ribbons of light drawn by the size and brightness of each dot.

components.name: hamburger-sheet
components.title: Hamburger Sheet
components.description: A menu button that grows into its own sheet: the shape unfolds from the button's corner while the three lines cross into the close mark.

components.name: highlighter
components.title: Highlighter
components.description: A marker stroke sweeps across a key phrase.

components.name: hold-to-confirm
components.title: Hold to Confirm
components.description: A destructive-action button that has to be held down; a fill grows across it and drains back if released early.

components.name: horizon-gradient
components.title: Horizon Gradient
components.description: Black fading through deep blue to white in bands that arch like a horizon, breathing slowly.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover Card
components.description: A preview card that opens while you rest on a link and stays while you move into it, so its own links work.

components.name: hover-weight
components.title: Hover Weight
components.description: Letters grow heavier as the cursor nears them.

components.name: inline-confirm
components.title: Inline Confirm
components.description: A destructive button that splits into Cancel and Confirm in its own footprint, so nothing around it moves.

components.name: inline-edit
components.title: Inline Edit
components.description: A label that opens into an input in place, with save and cancel sliding out from its edge, then folds back to the new value.

components.name: jiggle-grid
components.title: Jiggle Grid
components.description: A home-screen grid you rearrange like on a phone: hold a tile and they all wobble, drag one and the rest spring aside to make room.

components.name: kpi-tile
components.title: KPI Tile
components.description: A dashboard stat with its change and a sparkline you can scrub, rolling the number to any day.

components.name: large-title-header
components.title: Large Title Header
components.description: A large page title that rides up with the content and docks into the top bar as you scroll, moving and scaling as one piece, with the bar filling in behind it.

components.name: lean-scramble
components.title: Lean and Scramble
components.description: Words lean and scramble under the cursor.

components.name: light-badge
components.title: Light Badge
components.description: A badge lit from below by a rotating gradient stroke and soft rays.

components.name: light-rain
components.title: Light Rain
components.description: Thin lines of blue light falling through the dark, with bright glints sliding along them.

components.name: light-stream
components.title: Light Stream
components.description: An hourglass of fine iridescent light streaks with glittering dust, flowing through the dark.

components.name: line-rise
components.title: Line-by-line Rise
components.description: Each wrapped line rises into place in turn.

components.name: liquid-progress
components.title: Liquid Progress
components.description: A simple progress bar with a liquid feel: tones of one colour that brighten as it fills, a soft shine, and a front that settles with a small wobble.

components.name: live-kbd
components.title: Live Kbd
components.description: Shortcut keycaps that sink as you press the real keys, then fire the action, so people learn the shortcut by using it.

components.name: loading-shimmer
components.title: Loading Shimmer
components.description: A light sweep across text while something loads.

components.name: marquee
components.title: Marquee
components.description: An endless, seamless row of logos, quotes or tags that slows on hover and fades out at the edges.

components.name: morphing-popover
components.title: Morphing Popover
components.description: A button that grows into a panel by springing its real size and corners, so nothing stretches, then folds back into the button.

components.name: mute-toggle
components.title: Mute Toggle
components.description: A sound toggle whose waves fold away one at a time before a slash cuts through the speaker, and come back in reverse.

components.name: notification-bell
components.title: Notification Bell
components.description: A notification bell that swings when something new arrives, rolls its badge count up, and drops the badge into the bell once read.

components.name: notification-stack
components.title: Notification Stack
components.description: Notifications that pile up as panes of frosted glass, fan out on hover and blur away when swiped.

components.name: nps-strip
components.title: NPS Strip
components.description: A 0 to 10 recommend score on one track: the pick slides between scores in its group's colour, a band below lights the group, and the follow-up question changes for detractors, passives and promoters.

components.name: on-this-page
components.title: On This Page
components.description: A section outline where a dot rides a rail with your scroll, subsections fold open as you reach them, and clicking jumps to a section.

components.name: open-source
components.title: Open Source
components.description: A repository card whose stars, forks and contributor count roll up digit by digit on view, with a sparkline that draws in, a language bar, contributor faces that slide in and fan open, and a live feed of commits, merges and releases.

components.name: org-chart
components.title: Org Chart
components.description: A pan-and-zoom org chart whose teams grow out of and fold back into their manager, with search that flies to a person, a minimap and profile cards.

components.name: outline-fill
components.title: Outline then Fill
components.description: Letters are drawn as outlines, then filled in.

components.name: package-tracker
components.title: Package Tracker
components.description: A parcel on its way, in one wide card. On the left, an isometric city with buildings, parks, traffic and drifting cloud shadows; the route is traced along the streets, numbered pins drop in as each stop is reached and a van drives from one to the next. At the door the van hands the parcel over, the house lights up and the card turns green, and on autoplay the run starts over. On the right, the delivery window narrows as stops go by and counts the drops before yours on the last street, with the driver (call and message), the parcel's details and tracking steps that tick off as the van arrives. Stacks on narrow screens.

components.name: page-indicator
components.title: Page Indicator
components.description: Pagination dashes you can click, scrub, step with arrows or type into.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Pagination that never changes width: the current-page pill slides between slots, page numbers roll like an odometer when the window shifts, and an ellipsis opens into a jump-to-page field.

components.name: particle-scatter
components.title: Particle Scatter
components.description: Each press breaks the phrase into particles that regroup.

components.name: password-peek
components.title: Password Peek
components.description: A password field whose eye blinks as you toggle it, and whose characters rise into view left to right instead of snapping from dots.

components.name: plucked-curve
components.title: Plucked Curve
components.description: Text rides a curve that wobbles like a plucked string.

components.name: podcast-chapters
components.title: Podcast Chapters
components.description: An episode player whose waveform is split into chapters: the played part fills behind the playhead, the line being spoken writes itself in behind a two-colour gradient trail that settles into the text colour, hovering the waveform previews the time and chapter under the pointer, and the playhead drags with a grip that reads out where it will land. The transcript opens into a full list that follows along and seeks on click, bookmarks drop pins on the waveform, and the chapter list lights its stretch of the waveform on hover and fills as it plays; pass a src to drive it from real audio.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A panel that grows out of its button, flips when there's no room, and keeps its arrow pointed at the button.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: A quiet card of work in flight: each row is the app's mark, what's happening and a thin bar, and opens like a dropdown into facts, steps or one bar per destination. Values ease on a spring, percentages count with the fill, and finishing draws a check.

components.name: progress-dots
components.title: Progress Dots
components.description: Pagination dots where the active one stretches into a pill that fills as it plays, and the row opens into labelled steps on hover. Also comes as full-width story segments.

components.name: prompt-input
components.title: Prompt Input
components.description: An AI prompt box that grows as you type, with file attachments, a model picker, slash commands, @mentions, a send button that turns into stop, and voice dictation whose words settle in as they are heard.

components.name: pull-to-cursor
components.title: Pull Toward Cursor
components.description: Letters lean toward the cursor like a magnet.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio Group
components.description: A radio group where one dot travels to the option you choose instead of blinking, as plain rows or bordered cards with an outline that follows, with full arrow-key control.

components.name: read-receipts
components.title: Read Receipts
components.description: A message bubble whose clock turns into one tick, then two, then fills with colour once the message is read.

components.name: redact-reveal
components.title: Redact and Reveal
components.description: Black bars redact a line, then lift to reveal the next.

components.name: reject-drop-input
components.title: Reject Drop Input
components.description: A text input that lets go of characters it can't accept: a rejected letter appears where it was typed, blushes red, tips over its corner and drops out of the field under real gravity, fading as it falls, while a short hint says what the field takes.

components.name: request-waterfall
components.title: Request Waterfall
components.description: A network waterfall without the noise: a type icon per request, bars that draw in the order requests started, and hovering one pulls it apart into DNS, connect, TLS, waiting and download, draws guides at its start and end and dims the rest. Opening a row lays out each phase on the same time axis, and hovering a marker dims every request that finished after it.

components.name: ripple-to-still
components.title: Ripple to Still
components.description: Text ripples like water, then settles.

components.name: riso-flow
components.title: Riso Flow
components.description: A flowing gradient printed in grainy spot inks that drift slightly out of register.

components.name: rolling-word
components.title: Rolling Word
components.description: One word rolls to the next like a drum.

components.name: rust-text
components.title: Rust Text
components.description: Brushed steel type that rusts while you watch and flakes away, polished back to a shine wherever the pointer passes.

components.name: scatter-text
components.title: Scatter Text
components.description: Phrases shatter into particles that regroup into the next phrase.

components.name: scramble-text
components.title: Scramble Text
components.description: Letters resolve from random characters out of a soft blur, one after another.

components.name: scramble-to-word
components.title: Scramble to Word
components.description: A split-flap board scrambles to the next word.

components.name: scroll-highlight
components.title: Scroll to Highlight
components.description: Words light up as you scroll past them.

components.name: section-pill
components.title: Section Pill
components.description: A floating pill that names the section you're reading, with a ring for how far down the page you are, and opens into the full list, carrying the current title to its row.

components.name: segmented-control
components.title: Segmented Control
components.description: A segmented control whose pill slides between options on a spring, squishes when pressed and can be dragged across the segments like the one on iOS.

components.name: send
components.title: Send
components.description: File upload that fills, then launches a paper plane out of the card.

components.name: share-menu
components.title: Share Menu
components.description: A share button that flips open into a pill of options, resizing to fit.

components.name: silk-cloth
components.title: Silk Cloth
components.description: A sheet of satin rippling in a light breeze, with a long sheen along every fold.

components.name: silk-vortex
components.title: Silk Vortex
components.description: Liquid glass streaming outward from a dark void: glossy folds mapped through a colour gradient.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: A skeleton measured from the real layout: one bar per wrapped line of text, a box for every image and control, one shimmer across them all, and a top-to-bottom reveal when the content arrives.

components.name: sleep-stages
components.title: Sleep Stages
components.description: A week of sleep with a hypnogram per night: a block for every stretch of awake, REM, light and deep sleep, joined by a thin step, with the score and time asleep above. A strip of nights with score bars switches the chart, and the time asleep counts to each night. Each stage's share sits against its typical range; hovering a stage lifts its blocks, and scrubbing lifts the stretch under the cursor and reads its time and length.

components.name: slot-letters
components.title: Slot-machine Letters
components.description: Each letter spins like a reel and lands on the next word.

components.name: social-avatar
components.title: Social Avatar
components.description: An avatar that fans the person's social accounts out of itself along an arc, with real brand logos that copy the handle or open the profile on press.

components.name: soft-button
components.title: Soft Button
components.description: A plain button made with care: a gentle top-to-bottom gradient, a faint inner highlight and shade, and a crisp border, in primary, secondary and accent.

components.name: spill-textarea
components.title: Spill Textarea
components.description: A textarea with a character limit. A ring fills as you write and turns amber near the end; past the limit each new letter blushes red, tips over and falls out of the field, leaving an empty gap where it was, or stays red while a copy of it falls.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: A small family of loading indicators (ring, radial, dots, bars, orbit) drawn on one grid with one stroke and tempo.

components.name: split-accordion
components.title: Split Accordion
components.description: Sections that sit together as one block. Opening one splits it away from its neighbours with an easing margin, rounds the corners at the break and reveals the answer; closing it merges the block back.

components.name: split-bar
components.title: Split Bar
components.description: Parts of a whole on one bar, linked to a list, with segments that slide to new shares when the data changes.

components.name: split-button
components.title: Split Button
components.description: A primary button with a menu of alternative actions; the chosen one rolls into the main label.

components.name: split-panes
components.title: Split Panes
components.description: Resizable panes that follow the pointer exactly, snap into an icon rail when dragged past their minimum, and fold on their own when the container gets small.

components.name: stack-trace
components.title: Stack Trace
components.description: An error card that stays small until you need it: the error, how often it fired and a bar per hour, with the frame that threw on top. A click opens its source with the failing line marked, and the rest of the stack unfolds frame by frame with library frames folded away.

components.name: status-badge
components.title: Status Badge
components.description: One status pill that moves between states: the tint eases to the new colour, the icon turns in, the label rolls and the pill glides to its new width.

components.name: status-stamp
components.title: Status Stamp
components.description: An ink stamp slams down: approved, in review, rejected.

components.name: stepper-button
components.title: Stepper Button
components.description: An add-to-cart button that reshapes into a quantity stepper in the same pill.

components.name: story-ring
components.title: Story Ring
components.description: An avatar in a segmented story ring that spins into dashes while a story loads, then drains the arc you opened to grey.

components.name: strike-todos
components.title: Strike Todos
components.description: A plain to-do list: checking an item draws a line through it, and unchecking wipes the line away.

components.name: swap-fields
components.title: Swap Fields
components.description: A from/to pair whose fields trade places along opposite arcs when you press swap, carrying their values with them while the slot labels hand over.

components.name: sync-button
components.title: Sync Button
components.description: A sync button whose arrows spin while it works, coast to a stop instead of halting, draw a check, and keep "Synced 3 min ago" up to date.

components.name: tactile-toggle
components.title: Tactile Toggle
components.description: A single switch whose knob squishes under the finger, drags like the real thing and springs home on release.

components.name: tactile-toggles
components.title: Tactile Toggles
components.description: A settings list whose switches squish under the finger, drag like the real thing, sweep a faint tint across the row as they turn on, and pause the rows they override.

components.name: tag-input
components.title: Tag Input
components.description: A field that turns typed or pasted text into chips that pop in and shrink out, with Backspace to select and remove, arrow keys to move between chips and a nudge for duplicates.

components.name: tech-stack
components.title: Tech Stack
components.description: A row of real brand logos for the tools behind a product that open into tinted pills naming each one as neighbours slide aside.

components.name: testimonial-carousel
components.title: Testimonial Carousel
components.description: One large quote at a time over a faint oversized quote mark, with a pill pager below; the frame eases to each quote's height, and it swipes and steps with the arrow keys.

components.name: theme-switch
components.title: Theme Switch
components.description: Switches the page theme: the sun pulls in its rays and is eclipsed into a moon while the new theme spreads out from the button.

components.name: tick-nav
components.title: Tick Nav
components.description: A section list on a ruler whose ticks swell like a dock under the pointer, sliding each label out with its tick.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Toasts that stack, fan out on hover, swipe away, and follow a promise from loading to done in one toast.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A quiet tooltip that waits before the first one shows, then swaps instantly between neighbours in a toolbar.

components.name: topographic-lines
components.title: Topographic Lines
components.description: Contour lines of a slowly shifting landscape, like a survey map; the pointer raises a hill the lines ring around.

components.name: tracking-in
components.title: Tracking In
components.description: Lines open with a wide gap after every letter, and the gaps close one by one until the text settles.

components.name: tree-view
components.title: Tree View
components.description: A file and folder tree with folders that ease open, guide lines, a sliding selection and full tree keyboard control.

components.name: typewriter
components.title: Typewriter
components.description: Text typed with a human rhythm, mistakes included.

components.name: typing-dots
components.title: Typing Dots
components.description: A typing indicator whose bubble grows from three dots into the message itself, so the reply lands where the dots were.

components.name: verified-badge
components.title: Verified Badge
components.description: A scalloped verified seal in blue, gold or grey that stamps in with a turn, draws its check and catches one pass of light.

components.name: waitlist-input
components.title: Waitlist Input
components.description: An email field with its button inside that shrinks to a spinner, then settles into a confirmation in the same space.

components.name: zoom-past
components.title: Zoom Past
components.description: Words fly toward you and the next one arrives behind.
